user.title: PNZEO Camera
user.description: Add a PNZEO camera to Home Assistant

manual.title: Manual Entry
manual.description: Enter the camera UID (printed on camera label). IP address is optional for LAN-only cameras.

credentials.title: Camera Password
credentials.description: Enter the camera password (factory default: 8888). We strongly recommend changing it after setup.

abort.no_devices_found: No PNZEO cameras found on the network

error.cannot_connect: Cannot connect to camera. Check IP and port.
error.password_change_failed: Failed to change password on camera.
